verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the skills installed as a Claude Code plugin or copied into .claude/skills/. They are invoked explicitly via slash commands (/replica-backend, /replica-entrepreneur) and the docs say to 'run them in order'. Nothing documents automatic triggering from task context or SKILL.md descriptions engineered for activation. Any auto-discovery of skills comes from the host platform, not this product, so it earns no credit.
